context: Claude was showing a WebFetch permission prompt (code.visualstudio.com) but the indicator showed working instead of waiting_permission
rootCause: Subagent PreToolUse events cleared waiting_permission. PermissionRequest fired at 09:11:21.312 and 09:11:22.281 but PreToolUse at 09:11:22.281 and 09:11:23.461 overrode them back to working.
fixed: Sticky waiting states guard in applyTransition — PreToolUse/SubagentStart/PreCompact no longer clear waiting states (2026-02-24)

context: Stop hook fired at 13:11:44 while backgrounded subagents were still running; SubagentStop for aee66d5 and a0aed24 did not arrive until 13:35 and 13:37 (~24 min later) with no intervening UserPromptSubmit. The card showed white/stopped (and played the completion tone) while Claude was still busy.
rootCause: Stop was treated as session-done regardless of outstanding background work.
fixed: Background ledger + working_background (yellow) state: Stop routes to working_background when the ledger is non-empty, and drains to stopped (firing the tone then) when the last subagent/bash/monitor/workflow finishes (2026-07-13)

context: A completion tone dinged and the icon flashed white then back to orange while Claude was actively working. voiceop (reference) did not detect any stop. Claude had auto-compacted its context mid-turn.
rootCause: SessionStart hook with source=compact fired at 14:28:55 while working; the state machine treated compact SessionStart as stopped. Claude auto-resumed (jsonl:assistant) 9s later. Across all 42 historical compact events, every one fired while working and resumed — the rule was never correct.
fixed: Removed the SessionStart:compact -> stopped transition; SessionStart no longer affects state. Idle is signalled only by Stop; resume by the next assistant entry (2026-07-13)

context: Main turn Stop fired at 15:27:56 with two background subagents still running, correctly going yellow (working_background). ~1s later a subagent's PreToolUse (agent_id=a11139c756cc05c26) flipped it back to orange even though the main agent was idle and the subagent kept running.
rootCause: working_background was not protected from subagent-generated working signals: subagent PreToolUse fires on the main surface and was treated as a main-agent working signal. Confirmed via agent_id present on every PreToolUse/PostToolUse after the main Stop.
fixed: handleHook now ignores PreToolUse/PreCompact carrying an agent_id (subagent background work) for main-surface state and lastPreToolUseId; only SubagentStart/Stop consume agent_id. Yellow persists while only a subagent works and clears when the MAIN agent resumes (2026-07-13)

context: Session marked red as potential_error after a normal Stop. Claude had finished a turn discussing OAuth redirectUri validation ("non-string yields a 500. It doesn't — ... return 400"). User dump showed potential_error (read).
rootCause: PotentialErrorDetector matched bare "500" in the scrollback tail of a normal completion message (false positive). Detection logged at 2026-07-28T00:14:21.163Z for session 10aa96be (node bfabafc1 after restart), matchedText=500.

context: Surface sat orange (working) for 8+ minutes after the turn had visibly finished (last message: 'Pushed: 22d8b96 -> origin/main'). Decision log: hook:Stop applied 21:30:54.372 -> stopped (+unread), then jsonl:assistant applied 21:30:54.724 -> working, and nothing followed.
rootCause: Out-of-order transition apply. Claude's final assistant entry was stamped 21:30:53.339 and the Stop hook fired at 21:30:53.883 (544ms later, already outside TRANSITION_DELAY_MS=500). The JSONL watcher did not deliver the assistant entry until ~21:30:54.68, by which time it was past the queue's cutoff, so it drained alone and applied AFTER the newer Stop. The transition queue only sorts events it holds simultaneously; it had no memory of what it had already applied. With the turn over there was no later hook or transcript entry to correct it, and the reconciliation sweep only re-probes working_background surfaces.
fixed: applyTransition now keeps a per-surface source-timestamp watermark and suppresses any transition strictly older than the last applied one (logged with suppressed:true and the lag). Targeted waiting-state clears are exempt so the watermark cannot create a stuck waiting state; decision log entries now carry sourceTime so ordering is diagnosable. Regression test: 'a JSONL entry delivered after the Stop it predates does not resurrect working' (2026-08-02)

context: User ran /compact at 16:48:22 (PreCompact trigger=manual -> working). Compaction finished at 16:50:21 (SubagentStop for the summarizer agent, then SessionStart source=compact) and Claude sat idle at the prompt. The crab stayed orange with no tone; the user expected white + unread + ding, as for any other completion. Confirmed idle by the Notification hook at 16:51:23 (notification_type=idle_prompt). Same shape on surface 10ecbf22 at 2026-08-10T10:56:08 (manual compact, then 8 minutes orange until the user typed).
rootCause: A manual /compact ends a turn without a Stop hook. Compaction fires PreCompact (a working signal) and SessionStart(source=compact), which is deliberately not a state signal because auto-compaction resumes mid-turn (invariant 11). Nothing else followed - no assistant entry, no hook - so 'working' was never corrected until the next typed prompt.
fixed: PreCompact with trigger='manual' marks the surface; the first <local-command-stdout> transcript entry while that mark is set routes to turn-idle (stopped, or working_background when the ledger is non-empty), suppressed over waiting states. The manual-specific evidence is the hook's structured trigger field, not the 'Compacted...' prose, which is version-dependent and has no probe behind it. Auto-compaction is untouched (invariant 11). A Notification idle_prompt backstop was implemented and then rolled back: zero counterexamples in 137 firings, but its remaining coverage was already handled by the watermark (invariant 16) and this fix, while its failure mode - relabelling an unmodelled attention state as a plain completion - was worse than staying orange. Regression tests in state-machine.test.ts (2026-08-11)
